question: _______ will be declared if the umpire thinks the batsman did NOT have a reasonable opportunity to score off the delivery.
solution:
The correct answer is **Wide.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A "wide" is declared by the umpire if, in their opinion, the bowler delivers the ball outside the batsman's reach, and the batsman, in normal circumstances, would not have had a reasonable opportunity to score off that delivery.
 
• The wide rule is designed to prevent bowlers from unfairly restricting the batsman's ability to score by delivering the ball too wide of the batsman.
 
• Leg Bye: Leg byes are runs scored when the ball hits the batsman's body (excluding the hand) and the batsmen run.
 
• No Ball: A no-ball is declared for various reasons, such as overstepping the popping crease, delivering an illegal delivery (like a high full toss), or having too many fielders outside the prescribed fielding positions.
 
• Bye: Byes are runs scored when the batsman doesn't make contact with the ball, and the wicketkeeper fails to gather it, allowing the batsmen to take runs.
